page.title: About Us
page.text: G100: Group of 100 Global Women Leaders G100 Vision: To create an equal, progressive & inclusive environment for women worldwide. G100 Mission: To provide the thought leadership on what needs to be done for inclusivity, safety, economic & social empowerment of women globally, addressing genders gaps and achieving gender parity within this decade. There are 100 G100 Wings and each wing has its own Vision Statement as well in addition to the overall G100 Vision. What is G100? G100 is an empowered group of 100 women leaders from across the world, leading 100 global wings, supported by G100 He for She champions (Denim Club) and 100 Country Chairs for powerful advocacy, awareness & impact across governments and organisations for a gender equal future. G100 comprises a league of luminaries of eminence and excellence including Nobel Laureates, Heads of States, Ministers, Businesswomen, Philanthropists, Investors, Entrepreneurs, CEOs, Corporate and Community Leaders - a powerful Group of women leaders and achievers from all walks of life who wish to give back and move us all forward as architects of the future. G100 is an action + think tank that comprises 100 wings/sectors, led by 100 Global Chairs respectively, who further nominate 100 country chairs in 100 countries for global reach and impact. Country chairs further foster communities of 100 members directly or through further distributed leadership of region/state/city/district chairs. The blueprint is to have: 100 Global Wings. 100 Country Clubs. 100 Members. Million Gender Champions. G100 is supported by The Denim Club : Group of G100 He-for-She Champions globally, comprising leaders and luminaries from the business, corporate, political and other domains, who support the various G100 wings and chairs in their vision and mandate. Together, we advocate for equity and equality and mitigate barriers to women’s robust participation and leadership in all walks of life. The G100 Secretariat along with country convenors is leading the 100 meetings and missions globally. We regularly engage with influential policymakers, governments, corporates, universities, foundations, UN, IOs, G7, G20, EU, AU, GCC, Commonwealth among others. It is for the very first time that such a powerful global group of women and men has been constituted to address challenges and drive solutions across 100 different sectors. page.text: Founder G100 I ALL Ladies League (ALL) I Women Economic Forum (WEF) I Women’s Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (WICCI) I SHEconomy I Former Chancellor, Jharkhand Rai University, India I Chairwoman of the Board, SHEconomy Among 100 Most Reputable People on Earth (Reputation Poll 2019) Thought Leader, Global Icon & Visionary for Women, Businesswoman, Philanthropist, Author, Humanitarian, Spiritual Seeker and Compelling Speaker, Dr. Harbeen Arora Rai manifests multifaceted leadership with strength & simplicity. WOMEN EMPOWERMENT ALL Ladies League (ALL), Women Economic Forum (WEF), Women’s Indian Chamber of Commerce & Industry (WICCI), SHEconomy, G100 Club Dr. Harbeen is the Founder of five free platforms viz. G100, ALL, WEF, SHEconomy and WICCI. Like five fingers of the same hand, these platforms work together in solidarity, addressing various aspects of empowerment and bridging gaps to foster a more inclusive and equitable world. To summarise, the five sister platforms are focussed as follows: ALL Ladies League (ALL), a global sisterhood platform that embodies the spirit of She-for-She support and Shakti Bandhan, uniting women as "sisters beyond borders." Women Economic Forum (WEF), a conference platform that amplifies women's visibility, voice, recognition, and global networking, empowering women to pursue "business beyond borders." Women's Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (WICCI), an industry and business chamber driving women empowerment, through actions and advocacy for "policies beyond borders.” G100, a global platform for joint action, accelerating actions for "gender equality beyond borders." SHEconomy, an e-commerce platform and app that promotes women-owned businesses, strengthening "commerce beyond borders." With a powerful network reaching a million women worldwide, these empowering ecosystems are among the largest global communities of women. Supported by The Denim Club of He for She champions, all platforms cultivate communities in a spirit of All for All. In particular, G100 is an empowered club of 100 global women leaders from across the globe leading 100 areas of expertise with global vision and inclusive outreach in another 100 countries. Comprising a league of luminaries of eminence and excellence including Nobel Laureates, Heads of States, Ministers, Businesswomen, Corporate and Community Leaders – G100 is a powerful Group of women who wish to give back and move us all forward as architects of the future. page.title: Global President
page.text: G100 Global President A Global President is nominated every year by rotation from among the Global Chairs for a one-year tenure from January 1 to December 31. The Global President retains the portfolio as Global Chair of a wing, while leading as Global President in self-led initiatives. The Global President seeks proactive participation from all wings to develop ideas and actions with members worldwide especially in fulfillment of the mandate as shared below. The Global President can further expand the Presidents Advisory Council and also form ad hoc committees comprising leaders from across the G100. The Global President leverages support from Global Chairs, Country Clubs, the Denim Club, and the Secretariat for planning global outreach and meetings, particularly encouraging annual wing and global summits in coordination with Global Chairs. The role of Global President includes the following mandate in general, but each incoming Global President can prepare a personal and precise roadmap, selecting spheres of influence that align most with one’s strengths and networks, with strategic synergies and resourcefulness of reach and relationships. The Global President leads high-level global meetings and delegations, develops strategic partnerships, and invites influential leaders to the G100, to scale and strengthen our global influence and impact. The Global President plays a vital role in advancing the group's ELLEGOSSSE principles on the global stage, specifically for their adoption in policy development across governments worldwide. This is achieved through active participation in intergovernmental fora like the UN, EU, AU, G7, and G20. By engaging with these fora, the Global President helps shape policy agendas, promote international cooperation, and drive progress toward a more equitable and sustainable world. In addition, the Global President also engages with various collectives such as for parliamentarians, industry, trade, media, think tanks, business, associations, universities, and networks. This multi-faceted approach enables the Global President to foster collaborative relationships, promote knowledge sharing, and drive meaningful change with partners across the board. The Global President represents all wings at global events and conferences, signing agreements on behalf of the group. page.title: Top Women Leaders Worldwide on The President’s Advisory Council
page.text: presidents advisory council Top Women Leaders Worldwide on The Presidents Advisory Council. The G100 Presidents Advisory Council extends support to the Global President in driving positive change and advancing gender equality worldwide. G100 across its wings and councils brings together distinguished individuals from diverse backgrounds globally, including Nobel Laureates, Heads of State, First Ladies, Ministers, Philanthropists, CEOs, and business and community leaders, all committed to a common purpose: bridging gaps and giving back through solidarity, by leveraging their knowledge, networks, influence, innovation, resourcefulness, and leadership. H.E. Justice Dr. Jane Ansah H.E. Justice Dr. Jane Mayemu Ansah, SC, JA (Rtd), Vice President of the Republic of Malawi, is a distinguished Malawian jurist, legal scholar, author, and stateswoman. She is the second female Vice President of the Republic of Malawi, having assumed office following the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) victory in the General Elections held on 16 September 2025. A Senior Counsel (SC) and retired Justice of Appeal (JA), she has devoted decades of service to advancing justice, constitutional governance, electoral integrity, and human rights in Malawi and across Africa.Born on 11 October 1955 in Lilongwe, Malawi, she is the second-born daughter of the late Mr Kenneth Macpherson Mjojo and Mrs Ferrie Mjojo.She earned her Bachelor of Laws (LLB) degree from the University of Malawi, Chancellor College, in 1978. She later obtained a Master of Laws (LLM) in International Human Rights in 1996, followed by a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in International Human Rights from the University of Nottingham, United Kingdom, in 2002. She was appointed as Prime Minister by President Félix Tshisekedi on 1 April 2024, becoming the first woman to serve in the role. Excellency Tuluka obtained a master's degree in applied economics at the Free University of Brussels and a diploma of additional studies in Work in developing countries. page.title: Global Chairs
page.text: G100: Group of 100 Global Women Leaders H.E. Dr. Maya Morsy H.E. Dr. Maya Morsy is the President of Egypt’s National Council for Women (NCW) and holds the national award as one of the 100 most influential women in Egypt. Prior to this presidential role, Dr. Morsy served as the UNDP’s Gender Regional Advisor and Head of the Egypt Country Office for the United Nations Fund for Women, and also as Country Director of UNIFEM. Dr. Morsy has over 24 years of experience with national, regional, and international organizations through her work in the National Council for Women, the United Nations Agencies, USAID, academia, and the private sector. Her work experience has strengthened strategic partnerships with the League of Arab States, the European Union, the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation, the African Union, the Union for the Mediterranean, government organizations, civil society, academia, and the private sector. page.title: Country Club
page.text: G100 Country Clubs G100 Country Clubs refer to the totality of all the Country Clubs across the 100 wings present in a given country, Each Country Club is led by the Country Chair for a wing, in a country. Each Country Club comprises 100 or more members, who have been nominated in any of these ways: directly by the country chair; through distributed leadership of its State/Region and City/District chairs; with the support of the Denim Club Country Partner and the Country Advisory Council members — in the overall direction of the Country Chair, who works in solidarity with the Global Chair for the wing. Thus, at optimal capacity, every G100 wing, guided by its Global Chair, is supported by the respective wing’s 100 Country Clubs across 100 countries, each led by its Country Chair therein. So vertically, there are 100 countries under one wing. And horizontally, there are 100 wings in one country through the 100 Global Chairs. These are woven into the warp and weft of the Country Clubs. The blueprint is to have 10,000 Country Clubs (100 Clubs per wing x 100 wings). Country Clubs are informal and voluntary groups, connecting wing leaders and members across the 100 wings in a particular country. Country Clubs do not have any formal presence or any alternate leadership structure other than what exists wing-wise — they are freely formed in spontaneous spirit for building synergies across wings. The Secretariat regularly connects the various wings’ country chairs in respective countries as well as the resident Global Chair in that country. To join a Country Club, one is required to apply to the wing’s leadership; sharing your profile and how you’d like to support. To join a wing in your country, please Contact the Secretariat. page.title: Denim Club Partners
page.text: G100 Global Denim Club G100 is also supported by The Denim Club : Group of G100 He-for-She Champions globally, comprising leaders and luminaries from the business, corporate and political domains, each leading a sector of influence and having their companies and institutions in support of gender parity and equality. They will advocate for gender equity and balance, mitigate barriers to women’s leadership, commit to women’s greater C-suite representation, and fuel funding for female founders. Why ‘Denim’ ? Because it’s symbolic of our common ground. While men may be from Mars and women from Venus; and while girls may grow with pink and boys with blue, denim belongs to all of us equally as a place of comfort for cool and candid conversations. The sturdy denim stands for the solid dialogue between genders and the strength of solidarity that we aspire for. Together we can co-create a better, balanced world for All. The G100 Global Chair along with the G100 Global Denim Club Partner develop together for their G100 Wing policy recommendations to governments and multilateral institutions worldwide. The far-reaching impact will energise a million women by 2022, and 5 million by 2030. Together, in joint collaboration and co-creation, we are committed to join our forces and strengths for a better world toward defining, designing and determining a new future for ourselves with equity, equal opportunity, inclusion and economic empowerment of women, and of all, through the inclusive agency of women, supported by men champions. Membership to G100 and Denim Club is free and by invitation only. The endeavours are non-political, non-religious and non-dogmatic. We are co-creating a bold and beautiful model of working together in shared vision and aligned actions with gender respect, balance and parity. Our stellar example of solidarity is a shining testimony to the power of women and men walking together in purpose and mutual empowerment for the greater good of a more sustainable, balanced, progressive and peaceful world for all. page.title: The Denim Club Dialogues
page.text: Denim Club Dialogues The Denim Club Dialogues, facilitated by denim club partners and advisory council members, in coordination with respective chairs, aim to engage more male allies and He for She champions, toward promoting equality and bridging the gaps through inclusive conversations. These dialogues foster allyship, collaboration, solidarity and partnership, empowering hearts and mindsets to be inspired for change.
